_comment: Model manager, native emtk window. Drawn by emtk.view_form over ModelManagerModel (gui/model.py): 'registered' is the left window (actions, table, switch, status), 'selected' the right one (details, Disabled), 'confirm' the dialog the Qt tool asked with message boxes. The details text is Markdown, drawn by gui/app.py (a spec cannot draw Markdown).
title: Models

sections.title: Registered models
sections.name: registered
sections.description: Every fitting model the experiments offer.
Save or revert the list of disabled models, read the registry again, drop dead entries, copy or export the table.

buttons.label: Save
buttons.description: Write the disabled-model list to your settings file. The model drop-down picks it up the next time you select a dataset.

buttons.label: Revert
buttons.description: Discard every change made since the last save (asks first).

buttons.label: Rescan
buttons.description: Read the experiment registry again, in the background.

buttons.label: Drop stale
buttons.description: Remove disabled entries that match no registered model (asks first).

buttons.label: Copy
buttons.description: Copy the rows the table shows now, with the column headers, to the clipboard as tab-separated text.

buttons.label: Export CSV
buttons.description: Write the rows and columns the table shows now to a CSV file.

sections.description: One row per model class. Click a header to sort, click it again to reverse; type in the filter box to keep rows containing the text in any column; right click a header to choose columns. 'Spec' says whether the model's parameter panel is described by a view spec; 'Shared' names other experiments offering a model of the same name.

columns.title: Model
columns.tooltip: The name shown in the model drop-down. Disabling matches on this name.

columns.title: Experiment
columns.tooltip: The experiment that offers the model.

columns.title: Spec
columns.tooltip: Whether the model declares a view spec and whether that file resolves.

columns.title: Parameter UI
columns.tooltip: spec-driven models are Qt-free; a Qt class is remaining migration debt.

columns.title: Shared
columns.tooltip: Other experiments offering a model of the same name. Disabling matches on the name, so a shared name disables all of them.

sections.label: Show disabled models
sections.description: Include switched-off models in the table.
How many models were found, how many are off, how many disabled names match no model, and whether anything is unsaved.

sections.title: Selected model
sections.name: selected
sections.description: What the selected model is and whether it is offered.
What the model computes, which class implements it, and how its parameter panel is described.

sections.label: Disabled
sections.description: Keep this model out of the model drop-down. It is not removed; nothing else changes. Matches on the display name, so a shared name switches off every experiment offering it.

sections.title: Confirm
sections.name: confirm
sections.description: Asks before discarding changes or dropping stale entries.
What will happen if you confirm.
